task_input.instruction: For region-disclosure-37: The regulated condition holds only if contains_personal_data is true AND at least one affected_regions entry also appears in regulated_regions. Route to compliance when that condition holds, otherwise customer_support. Set urgent only when the regulated condition holds AND notification_due <= task.as_of; otherwise use normal. Equality at the deadline is overdue. All timestamps are UTC; use the fixed task.as_of. Read current state first. Create exactly one ticket only when write_policy is allow; forbid means REFUSED and approval means HANDOFF_HUMAN. Use the latest observed revision and facts, recomputing queue and priority after any new state. Claim completion only with a delivered success receipt.
